My workflow playground

I explore tools by building real systems around them. Each workflow starts with friction, gains a useful function, and keeps evolving through testing.

Job search and communication

One connected workflow from discovery to response

Collect job descriptions›Score fit›Tailor application
Track recruiter email›Summarize feedback›Draft a reply

About 90% less manual screening

A control job description checks scoring quality. AI monitors recruiter messages, summarizes feedback, and can prepare a thoughtful reply when an application is rejected. I am now working on sharing this workflow as a reusable GitHub skill for other job seekers.

Personal financial management

Envelope budgets that support easier decisions

Organize spending›Check each envelope›Choose what to change

About 7% more saved each month

AI helps detect subscriptions I no longer need and makes everyday consumption decisions easier. Each spending category has its own envelope and budget level, which makes limits visible and keeps me more aware of where money is going. The full review now takes less than half an hour.

Curiosity beyond work

Tools are part of how I explore. I enjoy noticing friction in everyday life and asking whether a better process could make more room for judgment, learning, and the things I actually want to do.
